text.arabic_uthmani: وَٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا۟ بِـَٔايَٰتِنَا هُمْ أَصْحَٰبُ ٱلْمَشْـَٔمَةِ

words.gloss_range: prefixed conjunction that links the adverse classification to the prior right-side verdict and lets the whole following construction serve as the counter-panel

supporting_anchors.ar: ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا۟ بِـ َٔايَٰتِنَا هُمْ أَصْحَٰبُ ٱلْمَشْـَٔمَةِ
supporting_anchors.tr: alladhīna kafarū bi-āyātinā hum aṣḥābu al-mashʾamati
supporting_anchors.display: {{ar:ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا۟ بِـ َٔايَٰتِنَا هُمْ أَصْحَٰبُ ٱلْمَشْـَٔمَةِ}} ({{tr:alladhīna kafarū bi-āyātinā hum aṣḥābu al-mashʾamati}})
supporting_anchors.gloss_range: the full adverse relative-and-predicate construction introduced by the conjunction

words.prose: {{ar:وَ}} ({{tr:wa}}) starts the ayah by fastening the adverse panel to the completed right-side verdict in 90:18. Because it is prefixed to the relative opening, its discourse work begins before the group is grammatically defined, and its scope reaches across {{ar:ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا۟ بِـ َٔايَٰتِنَا هُمْ أَصْحَٰبُ ٱلْمَشْـَٔمَةِ}} ({{tr:alladhīna kafarū bi-āyātinā hum aṣḥābu al-mashʾamati}}). The particle itself is ordinary coordination, not an overt adversative, but the paired side-titles across 90:18-19 make that coordination carry right-left antithesis rather than a detached restart.

topics.headline: conjunction links the whole adverse construction
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the opening particle links the entire adverse classification to 90:18, not only the next word.
topics.reason: QAC identifies the word as a conjunction prefixed to the relative pronoun, and attachment evidence treats the whole ayah as one nominal classification frame.

topics.headline: ordinary coordination carries right-left contrast
topics.reader_payoff: The reader hears 90:19 as the counter-class to the right-side title in 90:18, with coordination becoming paired sorting.
topics.reason: The CRITICAL rows explicitly connect the initial conjunction to the 90:18 title, while translation support warns that the two companion titles should be read together.

words.gloss_range: definite masculine plural relative pronoun that makes the adverse group identifiable by the following sign-denial clause before the verdict title arrives

supporting_anchors.gloss_range: the defining relative clause attached to the pronoun
the resumed predicate verdict after the defining clause

words.prose: {{ar:ٱلَّذِينَ}} ({{tr:alladhīna}}) does not merely point at a known group; it requires the following clause to define them. The adverse class is first constituted by {{ar:كَفَرُوا۟ بِـ َٔايَٰتِنَا}} ({{tr:kafarū bi-āyātinā}}), so the verdict title comes after a stated criterion. Its masculine plural form keeps the charge attached to responsible agents, not to an abstract disbelief, and the later predicate {{ar:هُمْ أَصْحَٰبُ ٱلْمَشْـَٔمَةِ}} ({{tr:hum aṣḥābu al-mashʾamati}}) resumes that same group. Against the compact pointing of 90:18, this relative opening makes the negative panel slower and more evidentiary.

topics.headline: relative pronoun defines the group by conduct
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees the adverse identity built from rejection of signs before the label is given.
topics.reason: The word is a masculine plural relative pronoun, and the local relative clause 90:19:3-5 defines it before the pronoun at 90:19:6 resumes it for the predicate.

topics.headline: plural form fixes responsible agents
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the ayah judges a plural human cohort whose action is grammatically marked, not an impersonal abstraction.
topics.reason: The plural relative pronoun controls the 3MP verb and is resumed by a plural independent pronoun before the predicate.

topics.headline: negative panel replaces pointing with definition
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the shift from 90:18's demonstrative recognition to 90:19's criterion-based description.
topics.reason: The CRITICAL rows contrast the 90:18 demonstrative frame with the relative construction that expands the adverse panel before its title.

words.gloss_range: perfect 3MP Form I act of rejecting or covering over the speaker-owned signs through a following bi-governed complement; not objectless disbelief
words.root_gloss_range: covering, concealment, unbelief, rejection, ingratitude, repudiation, seed-covering, expiation, and other cover-related branches; local grammar selects sign-directed denial and repudiation

supporting_anchors.gloss_range: the prepositional sign-domain that completes the verb

words.prose: {{ar:كَفَرُوا۟}} ({{tr:kafarū}}) supplies the charge inside the relative clause: a completed collective stance before the title is pronounced. The perfect 3MP ending carries the responsible cohort in the verb itself, and Form I keeps the refusal direct rather than causative or intensive. The covering image of {{ar:ك ف ر}} ({{tr:k-f-r}}) survives as reader payoff: signs are not absent, but treated as if unreadable or covered over. Because the verb is completed by {{ar:بِـ َٔايَٰتِنَا}} ({{tr:bi-āyātinā}}), the accusation is not generic unbelief; it is sign-directed rejection of disclosed evidence, with ingratitude and repudiation pressure sharpened by the speaker-owned signs. This makes the adverse title an outcome of a known sign-denial pattern, answering the faith language of 90:17 and recalling the signs-to-verdict formula in 2:39.

topics.headline: completed plural verb carries the cohort
topics.reader_payoff: The reader hears the rejection as an established collective stance by the same group defined by the relative pronoun.
topics.reason: QAC marks a perfect active 3MP verb, and attachment evidence identifies the subject as controlled by the masculine plural relative pronoun.

topics.headline: Form I keeps refusal direct
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the form presents the group's own direct refusal, without shifting the force to causing or intensifying disbelief.
topics.reason: The local surface is tagged PV:I, and the CRITICAL rows specifically contrast this with causative or intensive stems.

topics.headline: covering image sharpens sign-denial
topics.reader_payoff: The reader feels denial as covering over signs meant to disclose, with ingratitude and repudiation pressure attached to the local sign-object.
topics.reason: V4 supports covering, rejection, ingratitude, and seed-covering branches, while the local bi-governed complement narrows that pressure to refusal of the signs rather than activating every branch independently.

topics.headline: prepositional complement specifies the charge
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the verdict is grounded in a specified rejection of signs before the class-title arrives.
topics.reason: Attachment evidence marks 90:19:5, governed by 90:19:4, as the complement of the verb, and contextual data lists bi- as the top preposition for this verb profile.

topics.headline: sign-denial leads into verdict language
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees 90:19's adverse title as the result of a recognizable sign-denial pattern, not as an unexplained label.
topics.reason: The CRITICAL rows cite the contrast with 90:17 and the sign-denial to companions-verdict pattern in 2:39; both fit the local movement from clause to verdict.

words.gloss_range: bound preposition that governs the sign noun and makes the rejection object, domain, and evidentiary field explicit

supporting_anchors.gloss_range: the rejection frame in which the preposition governs the sign noun

words.prose: {{ar:بِـ}} ({{tr:bi-}}) is small in surface but decisive in grammar. It is segmented as its own word in the bundle, yet in {{ar:كَفَرُوا۟ بِـ َٔايَٰتِنَا}} ({{tr:kafarū bi-āyātinā}}) it binds the verb to the sign noun as one prepositional complement. That makes the charge more than objectless disbelief: the refusal is fastened to the signs as object, domain, and evidentiary field before the verdict lands. Its close-contact force makes the denial cling to the very evidence it rejects.

topics.headline: split prefix still forms one complement
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the separated particle and sign noun still function together as the complement of the rejection verb.
topics.reason: Attachment evidence makes the following noun a genitive complement governed by this prefixed preposition as part of the verb's complement.

topics.headline: bi relation specifies what is rejected
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees the accusation focused on divine signs rather than left as a generic statement of unbelief.
topics.reason: The local frame uses bi- after the verb, and bundle translation support warns that the target language may need to preserve this rejection complement.

topics.headline: contact force makes denial cling to evidence
topics.reader_payoff: The reader feels the rejection as grammatically attached to the very evidence it refuses, not distant from it.
topics.reason: The contact nuance is coherent as prepositional pressure, while local grammar narrows it to the complement relation rather than a free spatial image.

words.gloss_range: speaker-owned plural signs: verses, proofs, wonders, and readable indicators gathered as the bi-governed object-domain of rejection
words.root_gloss_range: sign, verse, proof, wonder, marked indicator, and disputed return/refuge associations; local grammar selects the sign noun while allowing the broader indicator field

supporting_anchors.gloss_range: the verb and preposition that govern the sign noun
the verdict reached after rejection of the signs

words.prose: {{ar:َٔايَٰتِنَا}} ({{tr:āyātinā}}) names the rejected object as speaker-owned evidence. Under {{ar:كَفَرُوا۟ بِـ}} ({{tr:kafarū bi-}}), it is the governed domain of refusal, so the charge is not general doubt. The suffix makes the signs definite by possession and keeps the divine speaker on the surface of the word; rejecting them becomes confrontation with the source. The plural gathers multiple sign-units, so verses, proofs, wonders, and readable indicators can stand together under one accusation. Intertexts such as the signs in horizons and selves (41:53) and signs in the earth (51:20) keep the sign-field wider than recitation alone, while the local grammar still selects the sign noun as the object-domain that leads into {{ar:هُمْ أَصْحَٰبُ ٱلْمَشْـَٔمَةِ}} ({{tr:hum aṣḥābu al-mashʾamati}}). The reported root dispute can add a return/refuge association to the image-field, but it does not replace the local sign sense.

topics.headline: possessive suffix makes the signs speaker-owned
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the rejected signs are marked as belonging to the divine speaker, not as anonymous evidence.
topics.reason: QAC and attachment evidence identify a first-person plural possessive suffix, and cross-reference evidence resolves it to the discourse speaker.

topics.headline: sign noun supplies the denied domain
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees the sign phrase as the bridge from the act of rejection to the identity verdict.
topics.reason: The noun is genitive under bi- as the complement of the verb, and contextual profiles show this form often functioning as a prepositional complement.

topics.headline: plural gathers many modes of indication
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the denied object can include verses, proofs, wonders, and readable indicators, while remaining one locally governed sign-field.
topics.reason: The CRITICAL rows support a broad sign range and the plural form gathers multiple units; missing V4 root rows do not contradict this, but local grammar keeps the range inside the governed sign noun.

topics.headline: root dispute remains background image-pressure
topics.reader_payoff: The reader can register the disputed return/refuge association as a background image without displacing the local sign reading.
topics.reason: The row names a traditional root dispute; local morphology and syntax still select the plural sign noun as the governed complement.

topics.headline: other sign scenes widen the evidentiary field
topics.reader_payoff: The reader connects the sign-denial phrase to broader Quranic scenes where signs in reality and signs in judgment become destiny markers.
topics.reason: The CRITICAL rows cite 41:53 and 51:20 for the wider sign field and connect sign vocabulary with judgment formulas; these parallels support range without controlling the local parse.

words.gloss_range: independent 3MP pronoun that resumes the defined group and makes the following construct title an emphatic nominal predicate

supporting_anchors.gloss_range: the accused group resumed by the pronoun
the predicate title following the pronoun

words.prose: {{ar:هُمْ}} ({{tr:hum}}) brings {{ar:ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا۟ بِـ َٔايَٰتِنَا}} ({{tr:alladhīna kafarū bi-āyātinā}}) back into view before the title. Its independent form is not a suffix tucked into another word; it stands as a visible identity hinge after the charge and before {{ar:أَصْحَٰبُ ٱلْمَشْـَٔمَةِ}} ({{tr:aṣḥābu al-mashʾamati}}). That prevents the predicate from floating away to an unnamed class and makes the title read as immediate identity in a verbless clause. The short closed sound also gives the verdict a pause before the open companion-title, while the contrast with 90:18's compact demonstrative makes the negative panel more explicit and forensic.

topics.headline: pronoun resumes the accused group
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees that the final title applies to the exact group defined by sign-denial.
topics.reason: Attachment evidence resolves the independent pronoun to the relative-topic group and marks it as opening the predicate statement.

topics.headline: independent pronoun sharpens identity
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the charge pause and convert into identification: they themselves are the adverse companions.
topics.reason: The local nominal clause has the pronoun before the predicate head, and the CRITICAL rows treat that position as an identity-separating hinge.

topics.headline: plural form preserves collective identity
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the same plural cohort carried from relative pronoun to verb to verdict.
topics.reason: The standalone 3MP pronoun matches the plural relative pronoun and plural verb before the plural title.

topics.headline: closed sound pauses before the title
topics.reader_payoff: The reader hears a compact stop before the title opens out, making the syntax hinge audible.
topics.reason: The sound observation is local to the pronoun and reinforces, without replacing, its syntactic hinge role.

topics.headline: negative panel becomes forensic
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that 90:19 identifies the adverse group more explicitly than 90:18's compact pointing.
topics.reason: The boundary rows contrast 90:18's demonstrative pointing with 90:19's relative clause plus pronoun before the predicate.

words.gloss_range: nominative broken-plural construct predicate meaning companions, possessors, adherents, or people characterized by the adverse domain
words.root_gloss_range: companionship, close association, possession, inhabiting, adherence, protective accompaniment, compliance, carrying along, and remote material/color branches; local construct selects durable class-belonging

supporting_anchors.gloss_range: the genitive adverse domain governed by the construct head
the pronoun subject whose predicate is the construct title

words.prose: {{ar:أَصْحَٰبُ}} ({{tr:aṣḥābu}}) is the predicate head after {{ar:هُمْ}} ({{tr:hum}}) and the first term of the construct phrase. It carries nominative predicate role while governing {{ar:ٱلْمَشْـَٔمَةِ}} ({{tr:al-mashʾamati}}), so the class-title is the main assertion and the adverse domain defines it. The root {{ar:ص ح ب}} ({{tr:ṣ-ḥ-b}}) makes the verdict durable belonging: the group is not merely near misfortune but characterized by company with it. The broken plural and substantivized title make a collective class, while the repeated head from 90:18 locks the two outcomes into mirrored architecture; the sound-shape reprises before the final side-word, and only the side-domain flips. The sign-denial setting also recalls the companions-verdict logic of 2:39, and the rare pairing with the adverse genitive points toward the title field of 56:9.

topics.headline: predicate head governs the adverse domain
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees the class-title as the main assertion, fused by construct grammar with the adverse domain.
topics.reason: Attachment evidence marks the word as predicate of the pronoun and head of the iḍāfa governing the final noun.

topics.headline: companionship becomes durable belonging
topics.reader_payoff: The reader feels the verdict as stable affiliation with the adverse domain, not a temporary location.
topics.reason: V4 supports companionship and close association, while local construct grammar narrows the broad owner, inhabitant, adherent range to a class-title.

topics.headline: broken plural makes a class label
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the verdict names a collective class matching the plural relative pronoun and pronoun.
topics.reason: QAC identifies a broken masculine plural predicate, and the surrounding pronouns and verb are plural.

topics.headline: repeated head creates mirrored verdicts
topics.reader_payoff: The reader hears 90:18-19 as one mirrored judgment system because the companion-head stays constant while the side-term reverses.
topics.reason: The rows explicitly identify the same-surah recurrence in 90:18-19, and translation support flags the contrastive classification between the two titles.

topics.headline: companions title follows sign-denial
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees the common companions label made marked by rare adverse genitive pairing and by the sign-denial verdict setting.
topics.reason: The cited rows connect the title field to 56:9 and the sign-denial to companions-verdict logic of 2:39, while local grammar keeps the current construct phrase operative.

words.gloss_range: definite feminine singular genitive adverse side-domain: leftness, ill omen, misfortune, and adverse allotment gathered as the final classifying term
words.root_gloss_range: leftwardness, inauspiciousness, ill omen, misfortune, adverse orientation, and side-allotment field; local construct selects the adverse side-domain opposite the right-side classification

supporting_anchors.gloss_range: the construct head governed by the final genitive noun

words.prose: {{ar:ٱلْمَشْـَٔمَةِ}} ({{tr:al-mashʾamati}}) completes {{ar:أَصْحَٰبُ}} ({{tr:aṣḥābu}}) and closes the surah on the adverse domain. As a definite genitive complement, it makes the title identifiable and complete, not an indefinite misfortune. The word gathers leftward side, ill omen, and adverse allotment into one final noun, so the classification is both spatial and moral. Its matching pattern with the side-term of 90:18 makes the right-left antithesis balanced, while rarity and final position concentrate the verdict in this closing label. The title field recalls 56:9, and the left-hand record scene of 69:25 sits downstream from this broader side-language. Canonical hamza gives the closing term a caught internal break, while qiraat gemination thickens or compresses its sound; the adverse classification remains stable.

topics.headline: final genitive completes the title
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees the final word as the definite adverse domain that completes the companions-title.
topics.reason: QAC and attachment evidence identify the word as a definite feminine singular genitive complement governed by the construct head.

topics.headline: leftness and ill omen load the verdict
topics.reader_payoff: The reader hears one word name side, ill omen, misfortune, and adverse destiny at once.
topics.reason: The CRITICAL rows support the left/adverse semantic field, while missing V4 root data keeps the derivational family as narrowed image-pressure rather than a validated branch inventory.

topics.headline: matched side-terms reverse polarity
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees 90:18-19 close as a balanced right-left antithesis, not as two unrelated titles.
topics.reason: The rows explicitly connect the final term to the opposite side-term in 90:18, and translation support recommends reading the two companion titles together.

topics.headline: rare final word concentrates the verdict
topics.reader_payoff: The reader feels the surah close on a marked adverse title rather than ordinary punishment vocabulary.
topics.reason: Contextual profiles mark the exact root/form as low occurrence, and the word is locally the final lexical item of the ayah and surah.

topics.headline: title recalls broader left-side scenes
topics.reader_payoff: The reader can connect the title to 56:9's adverse-side companions and to 69:25's left-hand record without letting those scenes control the local parse.
topics.reason: The CRITICAL rows provide concrete references to 56:9 and 69:25, and both are compatible echoes of the local adverse-side title.

topics.headline: variants alter sound without changing verdict
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that canonical hamza and variant gemination change the closing word's texture while preserving the same adverse classification.
topics.reason: The qiraat rows report sound-shape variation and also state that the adverse-domain classification remains stable.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The sequence كفروا بآياتنا ... أصحاب المشأمة joins an action upon signs to an emphatic, enduring left-side predicate.
baseline_models.mechanism: The signs are visible marks capable of orientation; kufr actively covers or rejects that visibility, while companionship turns a momentary refusal into sustained association with the leftward side.

activation_trace.role: Covering or rejecting truth supplies the active occlusion that initiates the mechanism.
A visible sign supplies what should disclose and orient rather than remain hidden.
Sustained companionship converts the act of refusal into a durable affiliation.
The leftward side gives the affiliation a spatial and directional terminus.

changed_reading.before: Those who disbelieve in the signs are simply classified as people of the left.
changed_reading.after: Those who actively occlude visible orienting marks become durably affiliated with a leftward direction.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: كفروا takes the signs as its object, and المشأمة can carry misfortune as well as left-sidedness.
baseline_models.mechanism: If the signs are disclosures of favor, kufr is not only doctrinal rejection but covering over what calls for acknowledgment. The resulting companionship is then with misfortune: an enduring condition generated around unacknowledged gift.

activation_trace.role: Covering a favor supplies ingratitude as the operative mode of kufr.
The visible mark lets a favor be disclosed and therefore knowingly unacknowledged.
Close association makes misfortune a settled accompaniment rather than an isolated event.
Ill omen and misfortune supply the adverse condition with which they become associated.

changed_reading.before: The verse contrasts belief and unbelief, then assigns the latter group an adverse fate.
changed_reading.after: The verse also diagnoses ingratitude: disclosed favors are covered over until misfortune becomes the deniers' settled company.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The plural act كفروا is followed by the emphatic plural identity هم أصحاب, allowing the act itself to explain how the company is formed.
baseline_models.mechanism: A branch of kufr is disavowal, yet the predicate names a company. The paradox is functional: shared repudiation can itself make people fit together and carry the same adverse orientation.

activation_trace.role: Disavowal supplies the relation-breaking act around which the negative company coheres.
Companionship supplies collective persistence despite the members' shared act of repudiation.
Making things accompany or fit supplies the inferred formation of a company around a common refusal.
Misfortune gives this socially produced fit its adverse quality.

changed_reading.before: The verse labels an already existing class of unbelievers.
changed_reading.after: The verse can depict a company continuously made by common disavowal, with repudiation functioning as its social glue.

context_deltas.mechanism: Division, a bounded civic place, and the loosening of a prohibition activate a juridical-spatial reading of المشأمة: the left is not merely mood or luck but an allotted station within a morally charged territory.

activation_trace.role: Rejection of truth supplies the conduct by which the station is characterized.
Sustained association makes the allotted station inhabitable as a lasting membership.
Left-sided direction supplies the side to which the company is allocated.
Division into shares activates allocation beneath the overt oath form.
A bounded tract supplies the spatial field within which sides and stations can be distinguished.
The loosening of prohibition supplies a legal-status dimension to presence in the bounded place.

structural_cues: 90:1-2 repeat the same city while changing the relation to it.
The emphatic هُمْ and nominal أصحاب predicate in 90:19 sound like settled assignment rather than a passing motion.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies division, boundary, and release-of-prohibition images; I infer an allotted juridical geography leading to the left-side predicate. A live alternative is that the opening only solemnizes the city and does not classify its inhabitants.

changed_reading.before: The left is a generic symbol for the condemned group.
changed_reading.after: The left becomes an allotted moral station inside the surah's bounded and legally charged geography.

context_deltas.mechanism: The arc from parent and offspring to an orphaned near relation and womb-like kinship activates the rare focus branch in which a son matures into a companion. Kufr as disavowal then reads as a rupture of the care that should convert generation into companionship.

activation_trace.role: Disavowal supplies the severing action that interrupts inherited and chosen obligations.
A son growing into companionship supplies an intergenerational possibility latent in أصحاب.
Misfortune marks the adverse company produced when that continuity of care fails.
Parent-to-offspring descent opens the generational relation that can mature into companionship.
A child cut off from a caretaker exposes where generational accompaniment has failed.
Kinship proximity makes care an obligation within a near relational field.
Womb and kinship imagery joins mercy to the same intergenerational field.

structural_cues: 90:3 opens a parent-offspring relation; 90:15 names a kin-near orphan; 90:17 names mercy; 90:19 names a company.
The focus plural allows a relational history, not only an individual verdict.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies generation, loss of caretaker, kinship, and a son-as-companion branch; I infer that fulfilled care turns descent into companionship and disavowal breaks that process. The live alternative is that أصحاب remains generic group-membership with no family coloring.

changed_reading.before: Companions of the left names a collective destination.
changed_reading.after: It can also name the adverse company left when generational and kin obligations are disavowed instead of matured into accompaniment.

context_deltas.mechanism: The repeated supposition that no one sees, followed by the gift of eyes, turns covering the signs into attempted counter-surveillance: the denier does not merely hide evidence from himself but behaves as though conduct can be hidden from every gaze.

activation_trace.role: Concrete concealment supplies the attempted hiding operation.
Visible marks supply the evidence the actor tries to make functionally absent.
Leftward orientation registers the directional consequence of refusing visible evidence.
Supposition supplies the actor's mistaken model that concealment succeeds.
Seeing by eye or insight supplies the gaze that defeats the concealment model.
The eye of care and watchfulness reverses the actor from watcher into one already watched.

structural_cues: 90:5 and 90:7 repeat أَيَحْسَبُ and أَحَدٌ around power and sight.
90:8 immediately answers the sight question by naming two eyes.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies mistaken supposition, seeing, watchfulness, concealment, and visible signs; I infer that the denial is a strategy of imagined invisibility. A live alternative is that the seeing language establishes accountability without describing the psychology of kufr.

changed_reading.before: Kufr is failure to accept disclosed signs.
changed_reading.after: Kufr becomes an attempted visibility-control regime: cover the evidence and act as though no gaze can recover it.

context_deltas.mechanism: Piled wealth and the boast of exhausting it are set against feeding during exhausting hunger. This activates kufr of favor as failed conversion: material abundance is narrated as self-expenditure rather than made to pass into another person's relief.

activation_trace.role: Covering a favor supplies the failure to acknowledge wealth through its proper outward use.
Visible signs make both possession and unmet need legible.
Misfortune supplies the social condition that accumulates when favor does not circulate.
Exhausting effort or substance gives the boast its claim of total depletion.
Accumulated wealth supplies the resource whose movement is morally at issue.
Layered material supplies the image of abundance heaped upon itself.
Feeding another supplies the alternative outward conversion of wealth.
Hunger joined with exhaustion supplies the urgent recipient-side condition.

structural_cues: 90:6 voices a first-person spending boast; 90:14 gives feeding in famine as the difficult-path action.
The two scenes ask not merely whether wealth moved, but toward whom and to what effect.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies piled wealth, claimed exhaustion, feeding, and famine; I infer that gratitude is tested by conversion of possession into relief. The live alternative is that the wealth was genuinely spent elsewhere, so the contrast critiques boastful accounting rather than hoarding.

changed_reading.before: Covering the signs is an abstract failure of belief.
changed_reading.after: It is also a material failure of transmission: favor remains enclosed in self-regarding expenditure while visible hunger goes unanswered.

context_deltas.mechanism: Made eyes, tongue, lips, and gentle guidance toward two manifest heights turn the signs into an embodied recognition-and-response apparatus. Kufr of favor then includes using the very capacities that disclose a choice to cover its demand.

activation_trace.role: Covering a favor makes endowed capacities morally relevant as unacknowledged gifts.
A visible sign lets bodily perception and guided alternatives function as disclosure.
Making and producing supplies the endowment relation rather than treating the organs as self-originating.
The seeing eye supplies reception of visible evidence.
The speaking organ supplies articulation and public response to what is perceived.
The paired lips complete the embodied speech apparatus and echo the paired alternatives.
Gentle direction toward a way supplies guidance rather than coercion.
Manifest elevation supplies two perceptible alternatives that can orient a choice.

structural_cues: 90:8-10 progresses from made sensory and speech organs to guidance toward two elevated ways.
The focus object بآياتنا can gather disclosures encountered through those capacities.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies made organs, visible perception, speech, gentle guidance, and manifest alternatives; I infer that these gifts participate in the sign-system they enable one to recognize and answer. A live alternative is that they are evidence for accountability but are not themselves the referent of آياتنا.

changed_reading.before: Our signs are external propositions or revelations that the group rejects.
changed_reading.after: The signs also arrive through endowed perception, speech, and guided choice, so denial recruits the gifts of disclosure against their own demand.

context_deltas.mechanism: The difficult ascent is unpacked as release and feeding amid poverty. These acts make the signs functional route-markers: covering them is refusal to cross a costly social threshold, and left-sided companionship is the trajectory produced by that refusal.

activation_trace.role: Rejection of truth supplies refusal of the route's disclosed demand.
Visible marks supply practical way-signs rather than information without consequence.
The left side supplies the route's adverse orientation and endpoint.
Perils and road difficulties supply the costly crossing required by the route.
A steep projecting obstacle gives the ethical sequence its topography.
Releasing a neck from bondage supplies the first concrete crossing action.
Feeding another supplies transfer toward need as another crossing action.
Poverty figured as adhesion to dust supplies the low point toward which aid must descend.

structural_cues: 90:11-16 asks about the obstacle and then answers through release, feeding, orphanhood, kinship, and dust-level poverty.
90:19 returns to a side-orientation after those route-defining acts.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies road peril, a steep obstacle, release, feeding, and dust-bound poverty; I infer that the acts are the operational content of the signs and that refusal determines direction. A live alternative is that they are independent virtues whose omission accompanies, but does not define, denial of the signs.

changed_reading.before: The group rejects signs and is subsequently placed on the left.
changed_reading.after: The group covers concrete way-marks encoded as costly liberation and sustenance, thereby walking itself into a leftward trajectory.

context_deltas.mechanism: Hunger, lost care, abasement, and dust-level poverty sharpen المشأمة from bad fate suffered into ill fortune socially produced. The company can be ominous because its covering of visible need helps bring misfortune upon others.

activation_trace.role: Covering truth supplies the refusal to let visible need make a binding claim.
Sustained association lets harmful omission become a collective social pattern.
The branch includes both misfortune and bringing ill fortune upon a people, opening an agentive reading.
Hunger with exhaustion supplies a concrete form of communal misfortune.
Severance from a caretaker supplies misfortune created by a missing relation of care.
Abasement in destitution supplies the social lowering sustained by neglect.
Adhesion to dust supplies the material extremity of poverty.

structural_cues: 90:14-16 concentrates visible vulnerability immediately before the reciprocal community of 90:17.
The focus uses a group noun, allowing distributed omission and distributed harm.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies vulnerable conditions and a branch that can denote bringing ill fortune upon a people; I infer that ignored need causally reproduces those conditions. A live alternative is that المشأمة names only the group's own adverse judgment and gives it no agency in others' suffering.

changed_reading.before: They are the people who suffer an unlucky or condemned outcome.
changed_reading.after: They may also be the ill-omened company whose collective covering of need manufactures misfortune within the human field.

context_deltas.mechanism: Reciprocal counsel, self-restraint, and tenderness generate the right-side company immediately before the focus. Parallel wording makes the left-side company relational too: one company sustains disclosed demands together, while the other coheres through their shared disavowal.

activation_trace.role: Disavowal supplies the negative reciprocal stance around which the left company can cohere.
Sustained association makes the focus group a practiced relation rather than a census label.
Left-sidedness supplies the orientation opposed to the preceding right-side company.
Mutual exchange of counsel supplies the repeated relation that actively makes a community.
Holding the self from collapse supplies the durability needed for reciprocal company.
Tender mercy supplies the affective force directing reciprocal practice toward another's need.
The repeated companionship term makes the two companies structurally comparable.
The right side supplies the explicit directional counterpole to المشأمة.

structural_cues: 90:17 uses تواصوا twice before 90:18 names أصحاب الميمنة.
90:18 and 90:19 repeat the same أصحاب plus side construction with opposed sides.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies reciprocal practices followed by right companionship and then parallel left companionship; I infer that practices form the companies rather than merely reveal preassigned memberships. A live alternative is that both labels are post hoc classifications and the practices only identify their members.

changed_reading.before: Two fixed populations are sorted into right and left.
changed_reading.after: Two coexisting social formations emerge: reciprocal patience and mercy make one company, while shared disavowal makes the other.

context_deltas.mechanism: The next ayah turns covering into a reversal: those who cover visible signs become the ones over whom fire is closed. Both mapped closure inventories converge on an enclosure or door sealed around its contents.

activation_trace.role: Covering and concealment supplies the action that is materially reversed in the next ayah.
Lasting association explains why the enclosure is not a passing encounter.
Misfortune supplies the adverse quality concretized by the enclosing fire.
Kindled fire supplies the material that closes over the company.
Closing tightly over something supplies enclosure around those previously doing the covering.
The non-dominant mapped inventory's firmly shut door sharpens the same reversal as sealed containment.

structural_cues: 90:20 immediately follows the focus and uses عليهم, placing the fire over or upon them.
The focus action and the following enclosure share a cover-versus-being-covered material symmetry.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies concealment, fire, over-them syntax, and two convergent closure images; I infer a measure-for-measure reversal from active covering to passive enclosure. A live alternative is that closure only intensifies punishment and is not lexically answering kufr.

changed_reading.before: Companions of the left is a status later followed by a separate punishment.
changed_reading.after: Their status already carries a material reversal: covering the signs culminates in fire closing over the coverers.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: The seed-covering branch is concrete and form-distant from the finite verb, so it should not replace the attested denial sense. It remains anchored in كفر and gains a visible packet mechanism through earth, opening, and fruit; downstream prose should mark it explicitly as an agricultural metaphor for suppressed potential.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: كفروا can activate the root image of a cultivator covering seed, while آياتنا supplies the marked potential being buried.

activation_trace.role: Covering seed with soil supplies a latent-growth image for the act of kufr.
The visible mark supplies what ought to emerge into recognition rather than stay buried.
Opening what is closed supplies the unrealized release of the buried sign.
Fruit reaching maturity and taste supplies the productive outcome the covered potential could have yielded.
Earth and dust supply the material medium in which seed-like signs are metaphorically buried.

changed_reading.before: They negate signs already fully presented to them.
changed_reading.after: Exploratorily, they bury sign-seeds whose recognition should have ripened into release and nourishment, keeping ethical potential underground.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: Protective accompaniment normally carries a positive valence, and the grammar does not explicitly personify misfortune. The inversion remains anchored in أصحاب plus المشأمة and is activated by the following enclosure; downstream prose should render it as a sinister reversal, not a lexical paraphrase.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: أصحاب can activate accompaniment that keeps or guards, while المشأمة supplies the adverse companion.

activation_trace.role: Protective accompaniment supplies an escorting and keeping function that can be inverted.
Misfortune supplies the sinister agent or atmosphere performing the inverted keeping.
Kindled fire gives the adverse accompaniment a concrete surrounding medium.
An enclosure containing what lies within supplies the escort's terminal form as confinement.

changed_reading.before: They accompany misfortune as members of its class.
changed_reading.after: Exploratorily, misfortune accompanies and keeps them in turn, becoming an enclosing escort whose protection has inverted into confinement.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: Remote-place and hidden-pass branches are noun-like and distant from كفروا, so they cannot displace the verbal sense of denial. They remain root-anchored and cohere with the packet's bounded city and sealed mountain-place images; downstream prose should qualify this as spatial coloring of denial as self-exile.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The كفر root can image a cut-off concealed place, and المشأمة gives that withdrawal a leftward direction.

activation_trace.role: A remote or cut-off place supplies spatial isolation as the result of covering the signs.
A hidden pass or enclosing height supplies concealed topography for the isolation.
Companionship makes the exile collective rather than solitary.
Leftward direction orients the concealed enclave away from the alternative side.
The bounded land supplies an outer civic space from which concealment can become withdrawal.
A place between mountains supplies the final closed terrain answering the hidden-pass image.

changed_reading.before: Denial is a propositionally wrong stance followed by left-side classification.
changed_reading.after: Exploratorily, denial is also collective self-exile into a concealed leftward enclave that finally becomes its own enclosure.

strongest_changes: Covering visible signs becomes a directional act that makes enduring leftward affiliation rather than merely preceding it.
Eyes, speech, and guidance activate the signs as embodied gifts, making kufr an ingratitude enacted with the very apparatus of disclosure.
Release and feeding turn the signs into social route-markers; refusal to enact them produces the leftward trajectory.
Parallel right and left companies are read as communities formed by reciprocal practices or shared disavowal, not only as fixed census classes.
The sealed fire reverses the root image of covering: those who cover the signs become enclosed from above.
summary.what_was_special: The focus ayah compresses epistemic concealment, gratitude, social formation, directional movement, and material enclosure into one short predicate. Context does not collapse these into a single verdict: it lets visible signs be revelation, endowed capacities, practical route-marks, and vulnerable persons at once, while leftness coexists as station, produced misfortune, and adverse company.
remaining_uncertainties: Whether المشأمة primarily marks a left-side station, misfortune suffered, or ill fortune produced remains deliberately unresolved.
Whether eyes, speech, guidance, and vulnerable need are themselves included in آياتنا or only illuminate the response to signs remains open.
The cover-to-sealed-fire reversal is textually tight but still depends on a reader-supplied causal symmetry.
The intergenerational, seed, protective-escort, and concealed-place readings are branch-backed but form-distant and should remain explicitly exploratory.

reader_a.activated_readings_md:
1. **Covering visible signs after being given sight.** Lexical evidence: ك ف ر B001 “covering/concealment,” B003 “rejecting truth,” B004 “ingratitude”; ء ي ي B003 “visible sign”; ع ي ن B001/B003 from 90:8. Structural cue: the ayah comes after eyes and guidance, and opposes the right-side companions. Assigned role: كفر covers; آيات are visible marks/signs. Abductive move: I infer that rejecting signs is a willful covering of what the furnished eyes should recognize. Reading change: disbelief here is not mere opinion; it is concealment and ingratitude toward visible disclosures.

2. **Left-side as misfortune-community.** Lexical evidence: ص ح ب B001 “companionship,” ش ء م B001 “left side,” B003 “ill omen/misfortune.” Structural cue: the formula mirrors 90:18 exactly, replacing الميمنة with المشأمة. Assigned role: أصحاب still creates company, but its orientation is leftward/ill-omened. Abductive move: I infer that refusal also forms companionship, a collective direction of misfortune. Reading change: the ayah reads as anti-community: people can be bound together by covered signs just as others are joined by mercy.

3. **Remote concealment against near obligation.** Lexical evidence: ك ف ر B012 “remote/cut-off place,” B001 covering; ق ر ب B003 in 90:15 “kinship nearness.” Structural cue: near orphan and dust-poor person preceded; here the signs are covered. Assigned role: كفر supplies distancing/concealing; قرب supplied nearness. Abductive move: I infer that rejecting signs includes making near claims seem remote or hidden. Reading change: the left-side group is marked by turning visible nearness into covered distance.
reader_a.retrospective_surprises_md: 90:20’s sealed fire made كفر’s covering physical. The earlier “ألم نجعل له عينين” made denial of ayat feel like misuse of eyes rather than lack of data.

baseline.text: Ayetlerimizi inkâr edenler ise, onlar sol tarafın insanlarıdır.

findings.text: İnkâr, göz önündeki işaretleri ve bu işaretlerin doğurduğu somut bakım taleplerini etkin biçimde örtme davranışı olarak belirir.
İnkâr, insana verilmiş geçim, ilişki ve merhamet nimetini tanımayıp onu başkasına aktarmayan bir nankörlük biçimidir.
Ayetler, ayrı ayrı okunabilen fakat birlikte özgürleştirme, doyurma ve merhametten oluşan daha büyük bir örüntüyü gösteren işaret birimleri olarak belirir.
Sol taraf da ortak bir yönelişle oluşan bir topluluktur; işaretleri birlikte örtmek, üyelerini kötü sonuca doğru kalıcı biçimde bağlar.
İnkâr, yakındaki yükümlülüğü uzak ve görünmez göstererek kişiyi ondan koparır.

channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_surprising_reach: Temporal order reaches Sunday, waiting in place, repeated prayer or pasture, alternating successors, pot residue, lingering illness, and a bad overnight state.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.name: Waiting and Imminence
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.scene_or_process: A watcher pauses while an expected arrival or event draws near.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.active_motifs: waiting and delay `ء ي ي:B001/m01`; watchful expectation `ر ق ب:B001/m01`; imminent time `ق ر ب:B002/m01`; delayed movement `ي ت م:B004/m01`
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.synthesis: Waiting measures the interval between present lack and expected arrival. Imminence shortens that interval, while delay prolongs it despite the object's nearness.

channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_semantic_invariant: Persons and things are distinguished as one, any, solitary, present, or self-identical.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_surprising_reach: Identity reaches unique pearls and poems, an image in the pupil, the essence of an object, a confidant as "one's own person," and universal reference under negation.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.name: Solitude and Unique Object
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.scene_or_process: A person or object stands apart from companions or lacks any comparable peer.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.active_motifs: acting or arriving alone `ء ح د:B005/m01`; unique pearl, poem, or isolated thing `ي ت م:B002/m01`; remote or cut-off place `ك ف ر:B012/m01`; remaining without spouse `ي ت م:B005/m01`
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.synthesis: Solitude can be deprivation or distinction. The same separation that leaves a person without relation can make an object rare because no equal stands beside it.

channel_subchannels_anchored_here.name: Right and Left Orientation

channel_subchannels_anchored_here.active_motifs: right hand and right side `ي م ن:B002/m01`; left side `ش ء م:B001/m01`; human-facing side `ء ن س:B004/m01`; directional route `ه د ي:B002/m01`

channel_subchannels_anchored_here.scene_or_process: Directional sides become signs of favorable or harmful outcome.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.active_motifs: blessing and good fortune `ي م ن:B001/m01`; ill omen `ش ء م:B003/m01`; visible sign `ء ي ي:B003/m01`; consequence `ع ق ب:B006/m01`
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.synthesis: Portent reads orientation prospectively. A side or sign is interpreted as announcing the kind of consequence toward which the person is moving.

channel_subchannels_anchored_here.scene_or_process: A person or group is identified by regional direction, country, or tribal affiliation.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.active_motifs: Yemen and affiliation to it `ي م ن:B005/m01`; Syria and movement toward it `ش ء م:B002/m01`; Ghassan clan name `ص ب ر:B016/m01`; Himyarite chief or ruler `ق و ل:B004/m01`
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.synthesis: Direction becomes social identity when regions supply names for people, clans, and offices. Yemen, Syria, Ghassan, and the Himyarite title locate affiliation within a geographic field.

channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_semantic_invariant: Communities distinguish leaders, administrators, honored lineages, and valued persons or property.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_surprising_reach: Standing includes a steadfast chief, royal intimates, a Himyarite title, inherited honor, full siblings, municipal supervision, best-quality goods, and principal capital.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.name: Chief, Courtier, and Royal Intimate
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.scene_or_process: A ruler or chief exercises standing through trusted people admitted near the seat of authority.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.active_motifs: steadfast chief `ح ل ل:B012/m01`; Himyarite chief or ruler `ق و ل:B004/m01`; favored courtier `ق ر ب:B004/m01`; crowned ruler `ك ف ر:B015/m01`
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.synthesis: Rank is organized by controlled nearness. The chief occupies the center, courtiers gain privileged access, and title or crown renders the hierarchy publicly visible.

channel_subchannels_anchored_here.name: Docility, Training, and Obedience
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.scene_or_process: A previously difficult person or animal yields to guidance and follows another's direction.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.active_motifs: submission after difficulty `ص ح ب:B003/m01`; docile camel `ت ر ب:B009/m01`; bowed compliance `ك ف ر:B014/m01`; directed conduct `ه د ي:B002/m01`
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.synthesis: Training converts resistance into coordinated following. The body lowers or yields, and guidance becomes effective because the subject now accepts direction.

channel_subchannels_anchored_here.active_motifs: skittish or chaste withdrawal `ن و ر:B006/m01`; coercion that drives obedience into disobedience `ك ف ر:B007/m01`; retreat on the heel `ع ق ب:B003/m01`; separation from attachment `ف ك ك:B003/m01`; guarded waiting `ر ق ب:B001/m01`

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi, bir şeyi örtme ve görünmez kılma çekirdeğini; zırhı giysiyle kaplama, silahla örtünme, külün toprakla kapanması ve yıldızların güneş ışığında görünmemesi gibi gerçekleşmelerle açıkça destekler.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Çekirdek fiziksel örtmedir; dinî inkâr, nimeti yadsıma ve günahı giderme bu dala girmez.

lexicalization_scope.note: Tanım yalın örtme çekirdeğini korur; zırh, silah, kül ve gök cisimleriyle ilgili kullanımlar bu çekirdeğin yapıya bağlı gerçekleşmeleri olarak ayrılır.

concept_map.definition: Bir şeyi başka bir şeyle örterek görünmesini engellemek veya kapalı duruma getirmektir. Zırhın giysiyle, kişinin silahla ya da külün savrulan toprakla örtülmesi bu işlemin özel gerçekleşmeleridir.

facets.statement: Bir nesnenin üstünü kapatarak onu görünmez veya örtülü duruma getirme işlemi.
Zırhı giysiyle kaplama, silahla örtünme ve külün üstünün toprakla kapanması çekirdeğin özel gerçekleşmeleridir.
Güneşin yıldızları görünmez kılması da görsel örtme sonucu üzerinden bu çekirdeğe bağlanır.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Kaynaklar örtme ve kapatma çekirdeğinde birleşir; farklı örnekler bu işlemin nesne, giysi, silah, kül ve gök görünümü üzerindeki gerçekleşmelerini gösterir.

concept_gloss.applicability: Bir şeyin üstünü başka bir şeyle kapatıp görünmesini engelleyen genel çekirdek için uygundur.

error_profile.preserves: Örtme işlemini ve görünürlüğün engellenmesi sonucunu birlikte korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Zırhın giysiyle veya külün toprakla kaplanması gibi somut bağlamlarda doğal bir karşılıktır.

error_profile.preserves: Somut bir nesnenin üstünün kapatılması işlemini eksiksiz korur.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Bu dal nimeti tanımamayı ve şükrünü terk etmeyi bildirir.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi sözün bir şeyden uzak olduğunu bildirme, onunla bağını reddetme ve ondan sıyrılma anlamında kullanılabildiğini açıkça söyler.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Bu dal bir inancı yadsımak değil, belirli bir şeyle bağı reddedip ondan uzaklaşmaktır.

lexicalization_scope.note: Anlam yalnızca bir şeyden uzaklaşmayı bildiren bağlı yapıda korunur; yalın köke genel bir ayrılma anlamı verilmez.

concept_map.definition: Bir şeyle olan bağı reddetmek, ondan uzak olduğunu açıklamak ve sorumluluk ya da aidiyet bağından sıyrılmaktır.

facets.statement: Belirli bir şeyle bağı reddederek ondan uzaklaşma ve kendini onun dışında tutma.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Kaynaklar bağlı kullanımın bir şeyden uzak olduğunu ilan etme ve onunla ilişkiden sıyrılma anlamı taşıdığında birleşir.

concept_gloss.applicability: Bir kişi, görüş, eylem veya sorumlulukla ilişkiyi açıkça reddeden bağlı kullanım için uygundur.

error_profile.preserves: Bağı reddetme ile o bağdan uzaklaşma işlemlerini birlikte korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Aidiyet veya sorumluluk bağının reddedildiği bağlamlarda açıklayıcı karşılıktır.

error_profile.preserves: Aidiyet bağını reddetme ve kendini dışarıda konumlandırma sonucunu korur.

lexical_glosses.target_gloss: bir şeyle bağını reddedip ondan uzaklaşmak

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Bu dal belirli bir bağlı söz yapısında ilişkiyi reddetmeyi anlatır.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Komşu dal kişi, iş, kusur ve kötülükten arınma, uzak durma, uyarma ve mazeret bildirme gibi daha geniş bir alanı kapsar.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: Bir kişi veya şeyle ilişkiyi reddetme ve ondan uzak durma iki dalda ortaktır.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Bu dal yapısal olarak bağlı ve dar bir ilişki reddidir; komşu dal genel uzaklık, arınmışlık ve sorumsuzluk bildirimlerini de içerir.

branches.neighbor_coverage_note: Bütün adaylar değerlendirildi; genel bağ kesme ve uzak durma dalı en yakın anlam sınırını verdiği için yayımlandı.

identity_judgment.boundary_note: Eylem kişinin kendi reddi değil, başka bir kişinin durumu hakkında adlandırma veya hüküm vermedir.

lexicalization_scope.note: Yalın biçimin ettirgen-hüküm verici anlamı korunur; suçlama veya zorlama gibi başka yapısal anlamlar eklenmez.

concept_map.definition: Bir kişiyi inançsız diye adlandırmak veya onun dinî gerçeği reddettiğine hükmetmektir.

facets.statement: Başka bir kişiyi inançsız diye niteleme veya bu yönde hüküm verme.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Kaynaklar eylemi bir kişiye inançsız nitelemesi yöneltmek veya onun hakkında bu hükmü vermek olarak açıklar.

concept_gloss.applicability: Bir başkasını dinî inancı reddeden kişi diye adlandırma veya böyle hükmetme bağlamında uygundur.

error_profile.preserves: Başka bir kişi hakkında niteleme ve hüküm verme işlemini korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Resmî veya öğretisel bir hükmün vurgulandığı bağlamlarda daha açık karşılıktır.

error_profile.preserves: Kişinin dinî durumu hakkında hüküm verme yönünü açıkça korur.

lexical_glosses.target_gloss: birini inançsız saymak veya öyle adlandırmak

neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Komşu dal bir kişiye hırsızlık eylemini yükler.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: Her iki dalda konuşan, başka bir kişiye olumsuz bir nitelik veya eylem isnat eder.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: İsnat yapısı ortaktır; ancak yüklenen içerik ve hükmün dinî niteliği bütünüyle farklıdır, bu yüzden olağan ikame mümkün değildir.

branches.neighbor_coverage_note: Bütün adaylar değerlendirildi; hırsızlık isnadı yalnızca katılımcı yapısını açıklayan yararlı bir yakın komşu olarak yayımlandı.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi başlangıçta itaat eden bir kişiyi baskıyla itaatsizliğe sürükleme sürecini açıkça belirtir; geçici çerçeve başlangıç durumu, zorlama ve sonuç ayrımını korur.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Genel zorlama değildir; itaat eden kişinin zorlanarak itaatsizliğe geçirilmesi şarttır.

lexicalization_scope.note: Yalın biçim, itaat eden kişiyi itaatsizliğe zorlama anlamıyla sınırlanır; yalnızca hüküm verme anlamına veya genel baskıya genişletilmez.

concept_map.definition: Başlangıçta itaat eden bir kişiyi baskı veya zorlamayla itaatsiz davranmaya mecbur bırakmaktır.

facets.statement: İtaat eden bir kişiyi zorlayarak itaatsizliğe geçirmek.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Kaynaklar aynı katılımcı değişimini verir: itaat eden kişi dış baskıyla itaatsiz davranmaya mecbur bırakılır.

concept_gloss.applicability: Başlangıçta itaat eden bir kişinin baskıyla itaatsiz davranmaya sürüklendiği bağlam için tam karşılıktır.

error_profile.preserves: Zorlama işlemini, başlangıçtaki itaati ve itaatsizlik sonucunu korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: İtaatsizliğin açık bir başkaldırı olarak gerçekleştiği anlatı bağlamlarında kullanılabilir.

error_profile.preserves: Dış baskıyla itaatten karşı koymaya geçişi korur.
error_profile.loses: Başkaldırı düzeyine varmayan itaatsiz davranışları dışarıda bırakır.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Bu dal hedefin önceden itaat etmesini ve zorlamanın onu itaatsizliğe götürmesini şart koşar.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Komşu dal herhangi bir kişiyi herhangi bir şeye zorlamayı genel olarak kapsar.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: Bir kişiyi istemediği bir davranışa baskıyla mecbur bırakma iki dalda ortaktır.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Bu dalın başlangıç ve sonuç koşulları belirgindir; komşu dalın zorlama çekirdeğinde itaatten itaatsizliğe geçiş şartı yoktur.

neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Komşu dal ayartma, aldatma veya isteği süsleme yoluyla doğru yoldan saptırmayı da kapsar.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: Bir kişiyi önceki doğru veya itaatkâr durumundan uzaklaştırma iki dalda ortaktır.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Burada belirleyici araç zorlamadır; komşu dalda ise yöneltme ve ayartma bulunabilir, mecbur bırakma zorunlu değildir.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi çiftçinin tohumu veya taneyi toprakla örtme işlemini adlandırmanın gerekçesi yapar; tekil ve çoğul kişi adları aynı eyleyen rolünü taşır.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Dal ekimin bütünü değil, tohumu toprağa koyup üstünü örtme işlemi üzerinden çiftçiyi adlandırır.

lexicalization_scope.note: Yalın kişi adları, tohumu toprakla örten çiftçi anlamında tutulur; dinî kişi nitelemesine veya genel ekim sürecine genişletilmez.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Kaynaklar çiftçinin adlandırılmasını tohumu veya taneyi toprakla örtmesine bağlar; tekil ve çoğul biçimler aynı eyleyen rolünü gösterir.

concept_gloss.applicability: Kişiyi yalnızca meslek adıyla değil, tohumu toprakla örtme gerekçesiyle birlikte anlatır.

error_profile.preserves: Çiftçi rolünü ve tohumu toprakla örtme işlemini birlikte korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Eylemin gerekçesi bağlamdan açıkça anlaşıldığında doğal kişi adı olarak kullanılabilir.

error_profile.preserves: Toprağı işleyip ekim yapan kişi rolünü korur.
error_profile.adds: Tohumu örtme işiyle sınırlandırılmayan bütün çiftçilik faaliyetlerini kapsar.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Bu dal tohumu toprakla örten kişiyi adlandırır.

neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: Tohumun toprağa verilmesi ve çiftçinin bu süreçteki rolü iki dalda ortaktır.

neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Gönderim örtüşse de adlandırma sınırı farklıdır: biri tohumu örtme, diğeri toprağı işleme ve meslek yönünü öne çıkarır.

branches.neighbor_coverage_note: Bütün adaylar değerlendirildi; ekim süreci ile genel çiftçi adı, eylem ve eyleyen sınırını açıkladığı için yayımlandı.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi günahı veya bozulan yeminin doğurduğu yükü belirli bir karşılıkla örtme, silme ve işlenmemiş gibi kılma sürecini açıkça destekler.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Çekirdek yalnızca bağışlama değildir; günah veya bozulmuş yemin karşısında yükü gideren bir işlem ya da karşılık bulunur.

lexicalization_scope.note: Günah yükünü giderme çekirdeği korunur; bozulmuş yemin için gerekeni yapma yalnızca ilgili söz öbeğine bağlı özel gerçekleşmedir.

concept_map.definition: Bir günahın ya da bozulan yeminin doğurduğu yükü, gereken karşılığı veya işlemi yerine getirerek örtmek, silmek ve işlenmemiş sayılacak duruma getirmektir.

facets.statement: Günahın yükünü örten veya silen karşılık ya da işlem.
Bozulan yemin için gereken yükümlülüğü yerine getirme, çekirdeğin yapıya bağlı özel türüdür.
İşlemin sonucu, kötülüğün işlenmemiş gibi değerlendirilmesi veya etkisinin silinmesidir.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Kaynaklar günahın veya yeminin yükünü gideren karşılıkta birleşir; toplu anlatım hem gereken eylemi hem de günahın silinmiş sayılması sonucunu korur.

error_profile.preserves: Bozulan yemin nedeniyle gereken karşılığın yerine getirilmesini korur.
error_profile.loses: Yemin dışındaki günah ve kötülüklerin giderilmesini dışarıda bırakır.

contextual_glosses.applicability: İşlemin günahı işlenmemiş gibi kılan sonucunun öne çıktığı bağlamda kullanılır.

error_profile.preserves: Günahın etkisini ve yükünü ortadan kaldırma sonucunu korur.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi üzüm salkımının çiçeklenmeden önceki kılıfını, hurma çiçeğinin kabını ve meyveyi örten yaprağı aynı örtücü bitki yapıları kümesinde toplar; bunlar yalnızca olgun meyvenin tek tip kabuğu değildir.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Dal güzel kokulu maddeyi değil, üzüm veya hurma çiçeği ile meyveyi gelişme aşamasında örten bitkisel kılıfları kapsar.

lexicalization_scope.note: Yalın ad biçimleri bitkisel kılıf ve kap anlamında tutulur; güzel kokulu madde, su kaynağı veya bitki anlamları bu dala alınmaz.

concept_map.definition: Üzüm salkımını çiçeklenmeden önce, hurma çiçeğini ya da gelişen meyveyi örten bitkisel kılıf, kap veya yapraktır.

facets.statement: Gelişen çiçek veya meyveyi dıştan örten bitkisel kılıf ya da kap.
Üzüm salkımının çiçek öncesi kılıfı, hurma çiçeğinin kabı ve meyveyi örten yaprak farklı gönderimlerdir.

error_profile.loses: Üzüm salkımı ve başka meyve örtülerini dışarıda bırakır.
